basis: ESTIMATED FROM AVERAGE: BLS May2025 national librarian/library-media-specialist median wage is $32.82/hour. Opening place wages use the national annual P10/P90 ($43,660/$103,990) converted at 2,080 hours, a modeled range rather than a local salary or loaded employer cost. Review-hours remain a noncompliant one-state gap: Massachusetts April2025 estimates thirteen hours; no broad national work-hours anchor was verified. Two legal-review hours are an authored bill provision. Counsel billing rates remain unread.
